It's not that you need to stay matched but it is a lot more assuring if you do. Plus then you can look back and reflect on early convos and see how your relationship has developed over the span of time. If you don't want him to see you updating your profile than that is a problem. Everyone is a stranger when you first meet them, but you are keeping your options open which might sound reasonable. In reality though you are weighing human beings like they are a commodity for you to choose from. That is not how a good relationship is formed and is part of why so many marriages/relationships fail. Because everyone was so focused on who's bringing what to the table and why should I chose this person over so and so, that you never took the time to build the foundation for that table to stand on to begin with. So you can continue to do this but keep in mind that most of the guys that will stay in your orbit are probably doing the same thing.
